body.statement: For every sample, the deterministic event inclusion \(\{\mu_n\in\mathcal U_n\}\subseteq\{\mathcal R_{\mathrm{ss}}(\mu_n)\subseteq\bigcup_{\mu\in\mathcal U_n}\mathcal R_{\mathrm{ss}}(\mu)\}\) holds by set inclusion, and the union on the right is \(\mathcal C_n^{\mathrm{inv}}\). Under ass:iid-triangular-sampling, ass:primitive-moment-envelope, and ass:primitive-covariance, for fixed \(p\) and \(K\), the fixed-dimensional triangular-array central limit theorem, uniform covariance consistency, and regularized Slutsky equivalence give \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{(P_n)}P_n\{\mu_n\in\mathcal U_n\}\ge1-\alpha\), and therefore \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{(P_n)}P_n\{\mathcal R_{\mathrm{ss}}(\mu_n)\subseteq\mathcal C_n^{\mathrm{inv}}\}\ge1-\alpha\). This supporting coverage guarantee is uniform over exact-zero and \(n^{-1/2}\)-weak coordinates of \(d(\mu_n)\), component-sign ties, and branch or optimizer-basis ties; it requires no divided-ratio or endpoint-optimizer limit law.
body.justification: This supporting lemma records that all probabilistic work is primitive-ellipsoid coverage, while the image-set inclusion itself is deterministic.
body.gap: KaidoMolinariStoye2019 supplies the general projection-inference template; the role here is to totalize its primitive covariance step and record honest coverage for the project-specific undivided union, not to claim union inversion as a new inference principle.
body.consumer: Empirical users receive one confidence set valid for the ACS application even when a state's observed coefficient change is indistinguishable from zero.
